# Song of Songs Chapter 1 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 412v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/SNG_001_page_001.jpg

---

**1:1** The-Song [shir] of-Songs [ha-shirim], which [asher] [is] to-Shelomoh [Solomon].

**1:2** Let-him-kiss-me [yishshaqeni] with-the-kisses [mi-neshiqot] of-his-mouth [pihu]; for better [tovim] [are] your-loves [dodekha] than-wine [mi-yayin].

**1:5** Dark [shechorah] I [am] and-beautiful [ve-na'vah], O-daughters of-Yerushalayim — like-the-tents [ke-ohalei] of-Qedar [Kedar], like-the-curtains [ki-yeri'ot] of-Shelomoh.

**1:6** Do-not look [al-tir'uni] at-me because-I-am-dark [she-ani shecharchoret], because the-sun [ha-shemesh] has-gazed-upon-me [shezafatni]; the-sons of-my-mother [immi] were-angry [nicharu] with-me — they-made-me [samuni] keeper [noterah] of-the-vineyards [ha-keramim]; my-own-vineyard [karmi shelli] I-have-not kept [lo natarti].

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

The Song's erotic poetry is rendered formally while preserving its sensuality. No allegorization is imposed on the text.

*— LOGOS*
